name: Admin manages internet plans and worker personal records
covers: admin edit plan price and specifications
admin delete unused plan with customer-history protection
customer plan selector uses active plans
archived plan history preserves existing customer records
admin delete staff account and revoke sessions while preserving historical records
invoice payment reconciliation from existing payments
cash operating summary and CSV exports
description: Verifies the administrator can customise plans and inspect an individual worker's own business activity.
setup: Create a staff account named Test Worker
Assign a customer to Test Worker
Record a customer payment while signed in as Test Worker
Have Test Worker check in and check out on a workday
Assign a task to Test Worker
steps: Open Plans & Pricing and create Test Fiber 75 with provider Test Network, speed 75 Mbps, data 2 TB and monthly price 749
Verify Test Fiber 75 appears in Active plans
Edit its price to 799 and verify the saved value
Search for Test Fiber and verify the result appears in the responsive plan list without horizontal carousel navigation
Archive the plan, verify it leaves Active plans, then restore it from Archived
Open the customer Internet plan selector and verify the active plan is available
Open Staff and choose View personal record for Test Worker
Verify the worker's payment total, payment row, check-in/out, assigned customers and tasks
expected: Plan create, edit, archive, restore, search and customer selection work; the worker's personal record shows only their own payment, attendance, customer assignment and task activity.

name: Admin controls staff shift start and end
description: Verifies the administrator can start and end a worker's shift and the worker's attendance record reflects both actions.
setup: Create an active staff account named Shift Worker
steps: Open Team Operations
Use Start shift for Shift Worker
Verify the worker appears as on shift
Use End shift for Shift Worker
Sign in as Shift Worker and verify today's attendance is completed
expected: Admin-managed check-in and check-out are stored in the same attendance record visible to the staff member.

name: Team chat, business summary and active-shift location
description: Verifies team collaboration, collection summaries and consent-based location visibility during an active shift.
setup: Sign in as admin and create active staff accounts Worker A and Worker B
Record a payment by Worker A
Create a group named Field Team and add Worker A
Sign in as Worker A, grant location permission and start a shift
steps: Verify the admin summary includes Worker A's payment and today's attendance
Send a message in Field Team as admin
Sign in as Worker A and verify the message, then send a reply
Verify the reply appears in the admin group conversation
Verify Worker B cannot access Field Team
Verify Worker A sees the location-sharing notice and periodic foreground location updates
Open Team Operations as admin, verify the location refreshes and open it in Google Maps
End Worker A's shift and verify the worker is removed from the live-location list
expected: Group access is limited to members, summaries include recorded business activity, and staff location is visible to admin only during an active shift while the staff app is open and permission is granted.

name: Finance billing, expenses and management reports
covers: CSV export for invoices, expenses and payments
description: Verifies monthly billing, expense recording, management totals and downloadable reports.
setup: Create one active customer with a monthly fee of 549
Record a payment of 200 for the current billing month
steps: Open Finance & Billing
Generate invoices for the current month
Verify one invoice exists for the active customer and its paid amount reflects the recorded payment
Generate invoices again and verify a duplicate is not created
Record an expense of 100 for office costs
Verify the expense appears and the cash operating balance reflects collections minus expenses
Export the invoice, expense and finance summary CSV reports
Delete the test expense and verify the audit log retains its deletion entry
expected: Invoices are generated once per customer and month, payments are reconciled into invoice balances, expenses persist and can be deleted, totals are correct and finance activity is logged.

name: Staff privacy, mobile navigation and preferences
description: Verifies staff privacy and key mobile navigation, language and appearance controls.
setup: Sign in as a staff member
steps: Open the mobile navigation menu and scroll to its bottom; verify the menu itself moves while the dashboard behind it stays fixed
Verify the Staff section is not available
Open Payments and verify only the signed-in staff member's own payments are visible
Select Hindi and verify common navigation labels change
Select Gujarati and verify common navigation labels change
Refresh and verify Gujarati remains selected
Switch to English, enable Night mode, refresh and verify the dark theme remains
Switch back to Day mode
expected: Staff cannot access admin-only or other workers' private records; the mobile menu scrolls independently and language and theme preferences persist.
